correctness.rationale: Boolean closure under preimage f^{-1} and Boolean operations consists exactly of unions of equivalence classes of states with identical forward color itineraries. Injectivity of itineraries requires primitive and mutually inequivalent rotational cycle words for same-length cycles and distinct labels on all same-successor fibers; if equal itineraries ever synchronize on the same cycle vertex, tracing back to the first merger contradicts fiber uniqueness. For each length l, primitive words P_q(l)=sum_{d|l}mu(d)q^{l/d} fill labeled cycles with factors P_q(l)-j l. Each cycle vertex has one precolored predecessor, so remaining d_v-1 predecessors contribute falling(q-1,d_v-1); noncycle targets contribute falling(q,d_v). This yields the product and exact q=2^r generator rank. Partition refinement gains at least one class per depth until discrete, proving depth <=n-s, with chain-to-loop sharp. Independent enumeration of all maps of size <=4 over alphabets q=1,2,3 compared 864 complete graph/color census cases via exact itinerary traces, including examples 24 and 18.
risk: Finite enumeration not an infinite all-cardinalities proof; the itinerary/independent-factor reasoning supplies generality.
